_note: Hand-built on Albert's instruction 2026-09-24 ('Keep but note it') for the 6mm line absent from PL-376. Appends one sentence to Salesperson notes; the existing text is kept verbatim. Nothing else changes: Active stays true, prices stay.

fields.Salesperson notes: Cost basis CONFIRMED 2026-09-10 by Albert: the list's single 'Price / SF' column is Titan's dealer cost, no multiplier. 4.5mm core + 1.5mm attached underpad = 6mm total, which matches the 6mm/7mm/8mm trim sizes on the accessory table. Core construction not stated; rigid vinyl defaults to SPC per the global rule. Underpad material not named; IXPE assumed -- verify with Weiss. Not marked * -- no Stairboard Set listed for this colour. 47 lb/box printed on the list; no box-weight field in the schema. The list's legend marks low stock by printing a colour in RED; verified against the PDF's character colours that NO colour name on any page is red, so Stock status is blank throughout. Weiss price list valid from Aug 1 2026. NOT ON THE SEPT 21 2026 LIST (PL-376): Weiss dropped the whole 6mm 12 mil line (Driftwood, Havenest, Venus) from its price list. Albert, 2026-09-24: keep it active and note it. Cost and retail are still the Aug 1 2026 figures, which no current list backs, so confirm availability and price with Weiss before quoting.
